situation: A family group chat: parents and their two adult children.
topic: A full-blown row: the mother calls the eldest a disgrace, the eldest mocks her faith and swears at her, the father shouts them both down, and the younger sibling takes sides.

text: John I need you to back me up here. I will not have Matthew speaking to me that way. You heard what he said.
Mum I didn't come round to get shouted at about my life choices. You started it.
That is not what happened and you know it. We were having a civil conversation until you decided to mock everything I believe in and swear at me.
guys come on
Susan, let's talk about this when things have calmed down. Matthew, that's not how we speak to your mother.
I wasn't being disrespectful dad. She said I was a disgrace to the family. How am I supposed to respond to that?
I said no such thing. I expressed concern about your choices and suddenly you're attacking my faith. That is different entirely.
can we maybe not do this in the group chat? 🙃
John?
I think everyone needs to take a step back this evening. We'll sort it out properly tomorrow.
how's everyone doing this morning
alright. you?
okay. been better. how are mum and dad?
no idea. haven't heard from them
Good morning. I hope everyone slept well.
morning mum. how are you?
I am fine, thank you for asking. I have been thinking about last night. I would like to have a proper conversation with Matthew when he is ready.
okay. i'm not sure what else there is to say though
Well there is quite a lot actually. But not in this chat and not now. When you have time, perhaps you could come round for a proper talk.
might be a bit busy this weekend
Matthew, your mother is trying to make peace. The least you can do is listen to what she has to say.
i know dad. i will. just not today if that's alright
bit of a stalemate then 😅
There is nothing amusing about this situation, Jessica.
i know mum, sorry
got some good news from work actually
oh yeah? what's that 👀
been asked to lead the new account team. bit of a promotion really
that's brilliant! congratulations 🎉
mum dad did you see?
Well done, Matthew. That is excellent news.
Congratulations, son. Well deserved.
cheers. thanks
anyone fancy a coffee tomorrow? i'm free in the morning
could do
cool, town centre around 10?
sounds good
